gloss: member (of a group, troupe, or organization)

definitions.gloss: member of a group / troupe / corps / squad
definitions.explanation: A person who belongs to an organized group whose name ends in -{団|だん} — for example a theater troupe, orchestra, children's sports team, fire brigade, scout group, or boys' and girls' club. The word identifies the person as one of the members, without specifying rank.

examples.english: To become a member (of the group).

examples.japanese: {合唱|がっしょう}{団|だん}の{団員|だんいん}を{募集|ぼしゅう}している。
examples.english: The choir is recruiting new members.

examples.japanese: {消防|しょうぼう}{団|だん}の{団員|だんいん}として{地域|ちいき}を{守|まも}っている。
examples.english: As a member of the volunteer fire brigade, I help protect the community.

examples.japanese: {劇団|げきだん}の{団員|だんいん}たちは、{公演|こうえん}に{向|む}けて{毎日|まいにち}{厳|きび}しい{練習|れんしゅう}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: The troupe's members keep up strict daily practice in preparation for their performance.

notes:
Composed of {団|だん} (group, corps, troupe) and the suffix -{員|いん} (member, staff member). Pairs naturally with any organization whose name ends in -{団|だん}: {劇団|げきだん}の{団員|だんいん} (troupe member), {楽団|がくだん}の{団員|だんいん} (orchestra member), {消防|しょうぼう}{団|だん}の{団員|だんいん} (volunteer fire brigade member), and so on.

USAGE:
Neutral in tone and widely used in news reports, recruitment notices, and organizational self-description. Because {団員|だんいん} only covers groups named -{団|だん}, it cannot be used for members of political parties ({党員|とういん}), societies ({会員|かいいん}), or ordinary companies ({社員|しゃいん}). The number of members is often expressed with the counter -{名|めい}, e.g. {団員|だんいん}20{名|めい} (20 members).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {団員|だんいん}{募集|ぼしゅう}: recruiting members
- {団員|だんいん}になる: to become a member
- {団員|だんいん}を{辞|や}める: to quit being a member
- {新|しん}{団員|だんいん}: new member
- {団員|だんいん}{数|すう}: number of members
- {団員|だんいん}{名簿|めいぼ}: list / roster of members

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {会員|かいいん}: member — used for groups whose name ends in -{会|かい} (society, club, association)
- {社員|しゃいん}: employee; company member — a member of a {会社|かいしゃ} (company)
- {党員|とういん}: party member — a member of a political party ({政党|せいとう})
- {組合員|くみあいいん}: union / cooperative member — a member of a {組合|くみあい}
- {部員|ぶいん}: club / section member — a member of a {部|ぶ} (e.g., a school club)
- {隊員|たいいん}: squad / unit member — a member of a {隊|たい}, such as a police or rescue unit
